Our Collection

How to Order

Ordering your custom sweets is simple. Follow these steps to make your celebration unforgettable.

01
📋

Choose Your Sweets

Browse our collection and select the products you love. Mix and match flavours, or ask us for recommendations for your event type.

02
🎨

Customise

Tell us your event details — colours, theme, quantity, and date. We'll personalise the packaging and presentation to match your vision perfectly.

03
✅

Confirm & Pay

Review your order via WhatsApp. We accept cash on delivery, bank transfer, or card payment. A 50% deposit is required for large orders.

04
🎉

Receive & Celebrate

We deliver your beautifully packaged sweets on the agreed date. Temperature-controlled delivery ensures everything arrives in perfect condition.

💡 Good to Know

📅 We recommend placing orders at least 7 days in advance for custom designs
🌡️ Store chocolates in a cool, dry place (16–20°C) away from sunlight
🎨 Custom colours, logos, and branding available for corporate events
💒 Free tasting session available for wedding orders of 200+ units

About Dona Chocolate

Born from a passion for chocolate artistry. Every piece is handcrafted with premium Belgian chocolate and the finest ingredients, creating unforgettable moments for your most special celebrations.

From intimate weddings to grand parties, we bring elegance and flavour to every event. Each creation tells a story of tradition, craft, and the pure joy of chocolate.
